_doc: Stream E. Vignettes: small hand-designed sites (PLAN §3.5). Each is a recipe placed by the bake (or tools/place-vignettes.mjs for the M1 zone). Coordinates inside a vignette are metres RELATIVE to its centre (+x east, +z south); the placement file gives the centre. Format: data/vignettes/README.md. `props[].kind`: 'prop' = highdef-3d/js/kit/rocks.js PROP_BUILDERS id, 'ground' = its GROUND_BUILDERS id, 'tree' = js/client/decor.js species (pine/fir/oak/birch, `dead: true` = leafless). `monsters` become a camp (type = Farhold bestiary id, `level` is added to the zone band's low end). `objects` become room objects (chest/note/npc/use). `lore` is the line shown when you first walk in (player-facing, plain language).

vignettes.name: The Hanging Oak
vignettes.blurb: A lone dead oak with a frayed rope and a shepherd's satchel under it; owls roost in it at night. Starts the 'A Rope for Old Pell' quest.
vignettes.lore: Somebody cut the rope down, but not before the crows had their turn. A satchel lies in the grass beneath.

objects.name: Shepherd's satchel
objects.text: Pell — the toll men at the ford took the flock money. I told them it was all we had. Tell my sister in Wamonhold I tried. — Aled

vignettes.name: The Overturned Cart
vignettes.blurb: A trader's cart tipped in a ditch; brigands are picking it over. A wounded carter hides under it and points you at the ford.
vignettes.lore: Turnips everywhere, a broken axle, and three men arguing over a barrel. Someone under the cart is trying very hard not to breathe.

objects.name: Dunnet the carter
says: Are they gone? Gods. They work for Hobb, at the ford. Hobb Gallowsby. Everyone pays Hobb.
Take what's left in the crates. Better you than them.

vignettes.name: The Dry Well
vignettes.blurb: An abandoned farm well that rats have turned into a nest; a hidden cache sits on a ledge halfway down.
vignettes.lore: The bucket rope has been chewed through. Something down there is squeaking, a lot.

objects.name: Cache on the well ledge
objects.hint: A loose stone in the well wall, about an arm's length down.

vignettes.name: Boar Wallow
vignettes.blurb: A churned-up mud hollow under the trees where a sounder of boars beds down; truffles in the roots. Grisel Thornhide's favourite spot.
vignettes.lore: The ground here is torn to black mud and smells strongly of pig. Something has been digging for truffles.

objects.name: Truffle patch
objects.text: You dig out a fist-sized black truffle. Somebody in Torborhold will pay for that.

vignettes.name: The Smugglers' Cellar
vignettes.blurb: A burned-out farmstead whose hay hides a trapdoor; two brigand archers watch it. The cellar holds the ford gang's stash.
vignettes.lore: The farmhouse burned years ago, but the hay bales are fresh. Nobody keeps fresh hay at a burned farm.

objects.name: Trapdoor under the hay
objects.text: Under the hay: a trapdoor, and under that a cellar full of other people's things.

vignettes.name: The Drowned Shrine
vignettes.blurb: Two pillars and a carved stone half-sunk in the marsh; wisps gather at dusk. Leave a coin in the bowl for a short blessing.
vignettes.lore: The water has swallowed the shrine up to its knees. Someone still leaves coins in the offering bowl.

objects.name: Offering bowl
objects.text: The coin sinks without a sound. You feel the marsh cold lift from your bones.

vignettes.name: The Duelling Stones
vignettes.blurb: A dolmen on a rise with two dead men in front of it and one fine sword between them; moths are at the bodies. Free weapon, small mystery.
vignettes.lore: Two men, two wounds, one sword. Whatever they were fighting over, neither of them won it.

objects.name: Crumpled letter
objects.text: Meet me at the stones at dawn and we will settle whose it is. Bring no one. — R.

vignettes.name: The Hedge-Witch's Garden
vignettes.blurb: A fenced herb garden with drying racks and a skull on a pole; her experiments (slimes) have got out of their pots. Her recipe note and herbs.
vignettes.lore: Neat rows of herbs, a drying rack, a skull on a stick. The skull has a little hat on. Something green and wobbling is eating the cabbages.

objects.name: Recipe, in a spidery hand
objects.text: For a cough: three nettle tops, a pinch of bog-salt, and DO NOT leave the lid off the slime jar again, Mabry.
